ABS Non-Conformity : Requirement 
PROC 0703 - Title: Cargo handling, revision 9
Section 5.3 : Before cargo operation, a loading stowage plan should be prepared by the in-charge port captain of the operation department. The loading stowage plan must be carefully reviewed by the master and/or chief officer pursuant to the conditions of corresponding drafts, stability, trimming, lashing, bunkers, fresh water, water depth of the berth as well as water depth at passage channel, besides the dangerous good should be check segregation by IMDG Code, so as to ensure safe navigation and environmental protection. 
Evidence
Based on samples taken from the MACS3-approved loading computer for the departure conditions at Semarang, Indonesia (18 May 2026) and Jakarta, Indonesia (21 May 2026), the following non-compliances were noted:
1. Jakarta, Indonesia (Departure on 21 May 2026)
a) 1 warning – Design stack weight exceeded at Bay 11, Row 04.
Maximum weight: 80 t / Current weight: 80.8 t
b) 3 warnings – Lashing force limits exceeded at the following locations:
Bay 09 – exceeded by 101%
Bay 11 – exceeded by 174%
Bay 26 – exceeded by 129%
c) A sample check of the DG information in the loading computer against the DG manifest found that “Marine Pollutant” and other critical information from the DG manifest had not been transferred to the approved loading computer.
2. Semarang, Indonesia (Departure on 18 May 2026)
a) 2 warnings – Permissible hold stack weight exceeded at ;
Bay 01, Row 01 - Exceeded with 185%
Bay 03, Row 01 - Exceeded with 172%
b) 11 warnings – Lashing force limits exceeded at the following locations:
Bay 14 – exceeded in the range of 160% to 195%
Bay 26 – exceeded by 101%
Bay 34 – exceeded in the range of 111% to 115%
c) A sample check of the DG information in the loading computer against the DG manifest found that “Marine Pollutant” and other critical information from the DG manifest had not been transferred to the approved loading computer.
3. Singapore (Planned departure on 23 May 2026)
The warnings noted at the previous ports of call under items (a) and (b) above were still active. A pre-loading plan from the PSA terminal planner was received on 22 May 2026; however, these warnings were not brought to the planner’s attention.
Before completion of this audit, a revised EDI was received from the PSA terminal planner, and it was confirmed that the previously noted warnings had been rectified prior to sailing from this port.
Nature
aa) The exceeded stability parameters were not addressed in accordance with company requirements and the approved loading computer requirements.
bb) No objective evidence was presented to demonstrate timely intervention by the vessel and/or shore planners to address the exceeded stability parameters.
Class - Prop. Shaft Survey once every 15 years
